ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity pixel distribution with a ratio of approximately 3:1 relative to low-intensity regions concentrated at the peduncle attachment and distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large light-toned (cream-white) contiguous regions spanning central lobes. Dark-toned (black-grey) clusters are localized at the median notch and terminal tips. Intermediate-intensity (tan-brown) mottling is overlaid across the light-toned surfaces of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 35-40 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 15% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary with high-frequency serrations; peak-to-peak periodicity varies between 3-10 pixels along the visible length of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the superior margins of both lobes, terminating in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Identification of discrete, dark-toned circular pixel clusters (under 5px diameter) on the light-toned background of the right lobe distal quadrant.

other_distinctive_markers: Pervasive non-homogenous tan/brown pigmentation patches across approximately 60% of the light-toned ventral surface area.
